==Constituent companies==
The number of companies in the index is dynamic and does not always amount to exactly 200. On average, the index is rebalanced every quarter by Standard & Poor's.<ref>{{Cite web |title=ASX 200 Today: Chart & Share Price News {{!}} Live Updates {{!}} Motley Fool |url=https://www.fool.com.au/latest-asx-200-chart-price-news/ |access-date=2022-05-01 |website=The Motley Fool Australia |language=en-AU}}</ref>
